An Arima Kinen where everyone gave their 
absolute all. Grass Wonder reached the 
very pinnacle of it.

Having lost an all-out battle, Special 
Week could no longer hold back her tears.

Grass Wonder comforted her opponent who 
had clashed with her with all her might, 
expressing her heartfelt gratitude.

"Grass Wonder has reached a major 
milestone. However, her journey is far 
from over..."
